name: O-6-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase

function.text: MGMT encodes methylated-DNA--protein-cysteine methyltransferase. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-methyltransferase activity and methyltransferase activity. It participates in DNA repair and negative regulation of apoptotic process.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: MGMT promoter methylation is a tumor-associated epigenetic mechanism of gene silencing studied in glioblastoma. A sequence variant, promoter methylation, and protein-expression result are different observations and should not be treated as interchangeable.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Gene-level alteration context supported by primary literature; pathologist review needed.
